reviews.title: Great Budget Ultrawide – Perfect for Work and Gaming
reviews.comment: I’ve been using this 34" curved monitor for both work and some Xbox gaming, and it’s been a great upgrade. The ultrawide setup makes a huge difference for productivity. I can keep multiple windows open side-by-side without needing a second monitor, which is perfect for design work, ordering, and multitasking. The curve helps everything stay in view without feeling stretched. Picture quality is solid—colors look good, and the IPS panel gives nice viewing angles. It’s not a high-end professional color monitor, but for everyday use, it looks great. Text is sharp and easy to read, which matters when you’re staring at it all day. For gaming, it performs really well. Smooth motion, no noticeable lag, and the larger field of view makes games more immersive. Works great with Xbox for casual gaming. Setup was simple, and it feels like a lot of monitor for the price. Pros: Huge workspace for multitasking Clean, sharp picture with good colors Great for both work and gaming Easy setup Excellent value for a 34" ultrawide Cons: Not a “pro-level” color accuracy monitor Built-in speakers (if included) are average Overall: If you want a big upgrade without spending a fortune, this is a solid choice. Perfect for business use during the day and gaming at night.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.comment: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Ultrawide Monitor – Perfect for Gaming and Productivity I’ve been using this monitor for a while now and I’m genuinely impressed. The 21:9 ultrawide aspect ratio completely changes the experience — both for gaming and everyday use. The 165Hz refresh rate feels incredibly smooth, especially in competitive games. Motion is clean, responsive, and there’s no noticeable ghosting. With FreeSync enabled, gameplay feels stable and tear-free. The IPS panel looks fantastic. Colors are vibrant (the 120% sRGB really shows), viewing angles are excellent, and brightness is more than enough even in a well-lit room. Text is sharp and clear, and the matte finish helps reduce reflections. Setup was simple, and the build quality feels solid. The on-screen menu is easy to navigate and has useful customization options. For the price, this monitor delivers excellent value. If you’re looking for a smooth high-refresh ultrawide display for gaming, work, or content consumption — this is a great choice. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Snir2_3

reviews.title: Some Issues
reviews.comment: I bought this monitor for Sim Racing and day to day computer work. Cons: Out of the box, the 165hz mode did not work very well on my system. I had a good amount of screen tearing that I tried to mitigate with a better power supply, good displayport cable, and NVIDIA settings. None of these fixed issues in 165hz. HDR does not work very well either and will result in the same screen tearing issues. The power supply and display cables in the box are not very high quality. Pros: 144hz works perfectly and is good enough for my use case. The IPS display is really good considering the price point. Mounts well to an standard monitor arm. This is a flat IPS, not curved, but the viewing angles are good and colors look good as well. Overall I would say this is a pretty good buy if you're looking for a wider monitor for work or casual gaming that doesn't require higher than 144hz.
